candidate.summary:
While at anchor, the crew noticed that several items,
namely cable wires and parts of the ship’s beam were
missing from the ship. The master subsequently confirmed
that no other losses or damages were sustained, and that
no further assistance was required. The crew were not
injured.
Upon receipt of the report, Coast Guard Station (CGS)
Manila immediately directed Coast Guard Sub-Station
(CGSS) Cavite City to conduct maritime patrol (MARPAT)
operations and establish contact with the ship. Thereafter,
all CGSS within the Cavite area were directed to conduct
shore patrols and maintain heightened vigilance, particularly
for possible sightings or recovery of the above-mentioned
items.

While at anchor, the crew noticed that several items, 
namely cable wires and parts of the ship’s beam were 
missing from the ship. The master subsequently confirmed 
that no other losses or damages were sustained, and that 
no further assistance was required.  The crew were not 
injured. 
Upon receipt of the report, Coast Guard Station (CGS) 
Manila immediately directed Coast Guard Sub-Station 
(CGSS) Cavite City to conduct maritime patrol (MARPAT) 
operations and establish contact with the ship. Thereafter, 
all CGSS within the Cavite area were directed to conduct 
shore patrols and maintain heightened vigilance, particularly 
for possible sightings or recovery of the above-mentioned 
 items. 
Some cable wires and 
parts of the ship’s beam 
were stolen. 
The crew were not 
 injured. 
Upon docking, Customs Border 
Protection officials boarded the 
ship for further investigations.
Two life rafts were stolen
Robbers in a canoe, armed with machetes approached an 
anchored container ship. Duty crew spotted one robber on 
deck and immediately raised the alarm. All crew members 
were instructed to remain inside the accommodation area 
and secure all access doors. Port authorities contacted but 
no response received. The incident was also reported to the 
local agent to notify the authorities. Two life rafts were 
stolen. The following morning, patrol boats arrived and 
recovered one of the life rafts, which was opened and 
unusable. Upon docking, Customs Border Protection 
officials boarded the ship for further investigations
While at anchor, a crew member was confronted by six 
perpetrators, reportedly armed with knives at Bay 02 on the 
forward part of the ship. The crew was threatened, ordered 
to remain silent and confined in the bosun store located 
beneath the forward mooring station. The crew member 
later freed himself and activated the fire alarm. The 
perpetrators briefly returned but were unable to gain entry, 
and subsequently escaped from the ship via the deck 
leading overboard. 
An immediate search was conducted onboard, with no 
perpetrators found onboard. The crew was not injured. 
Some unsecured items were stolen. 
Subsequent investigation by ship crew revealed that the 
padlock and securing arrangement of the bosun store door 
had been tampered with, indicating forced entry. The stern 
access to the engineer’s passageway was also found to 
have been tampered with.
The incident was reported to local Coast Guard and 
customs authorities.
Some unsecured items 
were stolen Nil
 IN PORT AREA
While at anchor, the duty crew noted that the cover of the 
hawse pipe of the starboard anchor was opened. After 
informing the 2nd officer, the general alarm, including the 
typhoon alarm was raised. A search was conducted with no 
perpetrators found on board. Subsequently, the master 
ordered an inventory and inspection of the deck equipment. 
The crew were not injured. Some ship property/stores were 
stolen.  
The incident was reported to VTMS Corregidor and Coast 
Guard Station (CGS) Manila. CGS Manila immediately 
directed the duty MARPAT team to verify the incident, and 
advised the Master to strengthen onboard security 
measures and increase roving duties to prevent similar 
incidents.
